title: Make It Stick
heading: Make It Stick
coreClaim: The chapter synthesizes retrieval, spacing, interleaving, calibration, and growth-oriented practice into a practical system for durable learning.
requiredAnchors: Durable learning comes from active retrieval, spacing, interleaving, and calibration.
The methods work best as a routine, not as isolated tricks.
Learning that lasts is designed through repeated honest practice.
